Stock market news | Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO 1.09x Subscription, ₹181-191 Price Band

Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) opened its IPO on 26 November 2026. The offering received a subscription of 1.09 times, indicating modest investor interest.
The company set a price band of ₹181-191 per share, and the public issue will close on 30 November 2026, after anchor bidding on 25 November.
